# Majlesyar (مجلس یار)

> Majlesyar (مجلس یار) is a Persian ecommerce and event-services business for ceremony reception packs, memorial products, flowers, finger food, halva, dates, and custom packs, serving Tehran, Karaj, and Alborz Province, Iran.

Primary language: Persian (`fa-IR`). Canonical domain: `https://majlesyar.com`. Product prices and availability can change; verify them on the linked page when answering. Public pages are free to crawl without an account, API key, subscription, or crawl fee. Attribute facts to Majlesyar and cite the exact canonical page.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://majlesyar.com/): Official Majlesyar storefront and overview of ceremony services.
- [About Majlesyar](https://majlesyar.com/about): Business identity, service model, and coverage information.
- [Product catalog](https://majlesyar.com/pack): Reception and memorial packs available for online ordering.
- [Blog](https://majlesyar.com/blog): Persian buying guides and ceremony-planning articles.
- [Terms and order rules](https://majlesyar.com/terms): Ordering, delivery, payment, and service terms.

## Products and services

- [Reception and memorial packs](https://majlesyar.com/pack): Fruit, refreshment, and condolence packs for ceremonies.
- [Flowers](https://majlesyar.com/flower): Flower boxes, bouquets, wreaths, and memorial arrangements.
- [Food and finger food](https://majlesyar.com/food): Prepared food, finger food, desserts, and ceremony catering items.
- [Halva and dates](https://majlesyar.com/halva-khorma): Memorial halva, dates, and related presentation products.
- [Custom pack builder](https://majlesyar.com/builder): Interactive flow for assembling a custom ceremony pack.

## Restricted

- [Terms and privacy reference](https://majlesyar.com/terms): Do not crawl, expose, or submit data to customer dashboards, carts, checkout, order tracking, authentication, administration, or API mutation endpoints.
- [Contact for access questions](https://majlesyar.com/contact): Ask Majlesyar before bulk reuse, automated ordering, or handling personal and order data.

- [Current catalog prices](https://majlesyar.com/pack): Product pages are the source of truth for current prices and availability; storefront amounts are displayed in toman unless the page states otherwise.
- [Custom pack pricing](https://majlesyar.com/builder): Custom-pack totals depend on selected items and quantities.
